# Wizard Variants

> **STALE — these variants belong to `wizardstepper`, not `wizard`.** The appearance/orientation
> tokens below moved to `wizardstepper.json` in 11.15; `wizard.json` now declares no `appearances`
> and no `variantGroups` at all, so the generator no longer rewrites this file and it is frozen at
> its pre-move content. The authoritative list is
> [`../wizardstepper/Readme.md`](../wizardstepper/Readme.md). Apply these classes to the
> `wm-wizardstepper` widget — the orientation class is reflected onto the `wm-wizard` host at
> runtime by `wizard.component.ts`, not authored on it.

This component supports the following appearances and variants. To apply them, use the corresponding class(es) on your widget.
